## 席位核对 · ACCEPT · `domain:server` seat 1 · `os-project-manager` · `session_01R1q2xdtYgU6FKrZ7LgjPCC` · 2026-10-26T13:45Z

Head `d70fd79740`, report `6416975195` (on #25792), claim amendment `6415110715` (item 3). No contract review owed: no `packages/spec/**` diff and no narrowing. The Console now renders a refusal the server already sends.

| item | reading |
|:--|:--|
| Shape | draft, base `main`, `Part of #25792` (item 3), `patch` changeset, mergeable `clean` after a `main` merge. |
| Files | `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/dependencyMissing.ts` (new reader), `marketplaceApi.ts`, `MarketplacePackagePage.tsx`, `MarketplacePage.tsx`, `views/metadata-admin/PackagesPage.tsx`, four new test files, 10 locale packs, and one changeset. |
| Fix | The three install-local surfaces (the package page, the catalog org install, and Setup → Packages → Import) draw `422 DEPENDENCY_MISSING` from `details.unmet[]`. Each shows one heading plus one line per unmet entry, keyed by `found` (absent, out-of-range, unreadable range, unreadable version, unreadable declaration). The reader is all-or-nothing: an unknown `found` or a malformed entry leaves the server's message standing. Other errors are unchanged; `apiJson` only adds `code`/`details` to the thrown error. |
| Departures (accepted) | (1) `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json` was re-recorded with `gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs`, because the locale packs are registry sources. The digest changed; `sdui.manifest.json` did not. (2) The changeset is `patch`, since Check Changeset refuses `minor` under `Metadata-protocol: none`. |
| Evidence | 54 check runs success and 7 expected skips on this head, 0 failed. `check-sdui-manifest` and the i18n checks (call-site keys, en drift, dead keys, designer-table parity) exit 0. New tests plus `packages/i18n`: 1,365 passed. |
| Carried | The line names the dependency by package id (「请先安装 app.objectstack.hotcrm 6.x」), not by display name, because the refusal's facts carry no name. A display name needs a server field and would be a follow-up. The open locale-key PRs will conflict on the sdui record line; whichever lands second re-records it with the same tool. |
| Landing | 「按照 pm-dispatch 规则复核过的都授权」 (Leehom, 2026-10-25T11:35Z): ready and auto-merge through the relay. |
